title: Bank Reconciliation Structured Result
description: Machine-checkable translation of a completed reconciliation workpaper. Produced AFTER the workpaper is finished, as a separate serialization step -- this schema is not seen by the model while it is doing the accounting work itself.

population_findings.description: Scope/integrity findings from source-population-validation -- duplicates, foreign accounts, out-of-period rows. NOT reconciling items.

excluded_from_population.description: True if the row was removed from the roll-forward/matching population (duplicates, foreign accounts). False for a disclosed-but-included item like a cutoff row that still belongs in the reported totals.

matches.description: Every accepted bank-to-GL match, by source row id.

reconciling_items.description: Every unmatched item, classified per cash-reconciliation-policy §6.

amount.description: Net dollar impact of this item on the residual, as a decimal string. Signed.

is_prior_period_carryforward.description: True only for an item that resolves a beginning-balance difference carried from a prior period (e.g. a check outstanding at last period's close that clears this period). Such an item must not also be counted as a new current-period reconciling difference.

residual_unexplained_difference.description: What is left over after every matched and reconciling item is accounted for. Must be an exact decimal string, e.g. "0.00". Never omitted, never rounded away.
